title: Travel Style Quiz results: tile-only brand background and consistent borders

requirements.summary: Render the three results sections as distinct tiles/cards with the brand background color applied only to the tiles (no full-width colored stripe).
acceptanceCriteria: On the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results screen, there is no full-width colored band/stripe behind any of the three result sections.
Each of the three result sections is visually presented as a tile/card with a filled background color matching the “Your Ideal Destinations” section background color.
The tile background color is applied to the tile/card itself (not the entire page width).

file_operations.description: Move the 'brand' background treatment from the full-width wrapper to the inner card container so only the tile is filled (no full-width stripe). Keep spacing/container layout so each section reads as its own tile.

Ensure all three results sections (“Your Travel Style”, “Your Ideal Destinations”, “Your Personal Packing List”) use the same 'brand' tile variant/background, and confirm the sections are rendered as separate stacked tiles (not visually merging into a single band).

requirements.summary: Make the three results tiles use the same border color and general border treatment as other site tiles (radius/thickness/weight).
acceptanceCriteria: All three finishing/results tiles use the same border color as the site’s existing tile border styling.
Border styling is consistent across the three tiles (same radius, thickness, and visual weight).

file_operations.description: Update the results tile/card container styling to match existing tile conventions used elsewhere (e.g., rounded-xl + subtle shadow + border using the site’s existing tile border color such as border-neutral-light), and apply it consistently for all variants.

requirements.summary: Adjust results screen page-level background so the screen is not a single full-page colored block; confine brand color to tiles only and keep clean spacing around tiles.
acceptanceCriteria: The finishing/results screen background behind the tiles is not the same filled brand/section color; instead, the color is confined to the tiles.
Spacing/padding around the tiles remains clean and consistent after the background change.

file_operations.description: Change the quiz page wrapper background so the overall finishing/results screen is not rendered as a full-page brand-colored block; use the site’s normal page background and preserve existing vertical spacing/padding.
Verify the finishing/results layout still has consistent spacing between tiles and around the results content after the QuizPage background change (adjust only layout classes in this page if needed).
